answer: The design leans on cryptographic attestation with threshold signatures. Written in a skeptical lens, addresses failure modes first register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Each submission hangs on the glacier of a task receipt, and the voyage is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the cedar of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
